post.description:
Submits the signal report a client SDK collected and answers with the complete verdict: the request ID, the visitor ID and its confidence, and the suspect score, level and triggers. There is no second call to make.

The client SDKs build and send this request. `signals` is produced by them and is not a public contract. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header, and the same value on every retry, so a retried identification is answered and charged once.

422.description: The request could not be validated.

post.description:
The one URL the browser SDK and every first-party proxy post to. A body with a `token` is a deferred report and is answered `202` with `request_id` and `duplicate`, exactly as the deferred report route answers. Any other body is an identification and is answered `200` with the complete verdict, exactly as the identify route answers.

It exists so a proxy can forward everything it receives to a single path, and so the SDK can post both calls to one path of the customer's choosing, with nothing appended that a content blocker could match across sites.
